applicabilityBasis.summary: hyperUSDCa is an ERC-4626 USDC lending-vault share. Its redemption value changes with accrued lending interest and realized strategy losses, and withdrawals depend on available liquidity. It does not establish an issuer obligation to redeem for a fixed amount of national-currency monetary value.

genius.notes: This assessment concerns Hyperithm USDC Apex at Monad:0x78999cc96d2Ba0341588C60CcB0E91c6C33CF371, independently of underlying USDC. Hyperithm branding identifies the vault strategy; the opened protocol API and documentation do not establish a legal issuer entity or corporate redemption obligor. issuerEntity is omitted rather than attributing the share to Circle or assuming a curator is its legal issuer. No GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization is asserted.
